item.title: SpaceX outlines plans for Starship test site at Kennedy Space Center
item.description: SpaceX plans a static test stand for Starship in Florida. Gwynne Shotwell said Florida launches could start later this year.

item.title: Elon Musk Says SpaceX Will Try to Catch a Returning Starship This Month
item.description: Musk told followers a tower catch may be attempted.
